title: Esther Saves Her People
description: Esther risks her life by going to the king and exposes Haman's evil plan to destroy the Jews, which leads to Haman himself being hanged on the gallows he had built for Mordecai.

versions.reason: [major] references: The reference overlaps with the existing story 'Haman's Plan to Destroy the Jews' (Esther 3:1-3:15). The new story covers the entire drama from Haman's plan to his downfall and should be merged with the existing one.
